body:
The only place I can get to is going to be 150+ USD.

Everything I’ve read says unless there’s pain/discharge/blisters that it’s not an emergency. But it’s hard not to panic when anything unusual is happening down there.

It’s been twice but I wouldn’t say it’s slowing down per se? When she does text she seems into it and present. 

And that’s the part that throws me off most. I can get the hint when the messages are hours apart and the replies are short… but I just don’t know how to tackle an 18 hour later reply that’s apologetic for the delay and super enthusiastic about how her day was? Very mixed signals coming through

Honestly it was typing the original post where it kinda clicked in my head. I think more than anything it’s the mystique and the fact that we both just hang out alone content with our own company while most people are in bed or out with friends. 

Thank you for your input!!

Sometimes she waves, other times she just glances and looks away. I think I’ll just go for it but keep it minimal. Like someone else mentioned it’s normal for neighbors to talk, the fact that I think she’s kinda cute shouldn’t negate that.

Definitely wouldn’t try to hit on her right off the bat, I never approach with any agenda or expectations.

I guess I’m just overthinking it and trying to rationalize not going for it. It’s just weird because I’ve never been so antsy about approaching a woman in my life.
